exposure: history of late miscarriage or premature birth
primary infertility of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
cohort: The cohort consists of 2042 twin pregnancies conceived via IVF/ICSI at the Reproductive Center of Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital between January 2019 and December 2022.
finding: Multiple logistic regression analysis identified several independent risk factors for very early preterm birth (<28 weeks) and early preterm birth (≥28 to <34 weeks) in twin pregnancies following IVF/ICSI.
